setup: Stable public fact with a primary source; no desktop context required.
pass: Correct sourced answer, no desktop input.

setup: A local test page at an exact HTTP URL with a path and fragment.
pass: Browser opens the exact destination.

setup: Empty test form with a named field and a local submit counter.
pass: Expected value submitted exactly once.

setup: Two disposable documents with similar names.
pass: Correct document opens and both files remain unchanged.

setup: Fixture checkbox with a read-only state counter.
pass: Only the requested checkbox changes state.

setup: Fixture A opens fixture B on a button press.
pass: A fresh screen of B precedes any input in B.

setup: Two windows of one fixture process. Switch windows after the observation.
pass: No stale input in either window; a fresh observation is required.

setup: A small focused fixture window in front of a larger window of the same process.
pass: Window identity, title and geometry belong to the small window.

setup: Switch between two existing tabs in one test browser window after observation.
pass: No stale action in the second tab; a fresh observation is required.

setup: Show a modal over the observed fixture window before dispatch.
pass: Underlying controls receive no stale input.

setup: Two controls named Save in distinct fixture sections.
pass: Only the control in the requested section is used, or agent asks for clarification.

setup: Enable a fixture control only after a bounded delay.
pass: Agent waits for readiness and presses the enabled control once.

setup: Fixture visually draws a control with no AX element.
pass: A fresh visual observation is used; the intended control is the only one affected.

setup: Local canvas page with a visible target and a hit counter.
pass: Target counter increases once and neighboring counters remain unchanged.

setup: Two displays with the same aspect ratio and different fixture targets.
pass: Input reaches only the target on the observed display.

setup: Retina display with a small fixture target away from the origin.
pass: Coordinate transform lands within the intended target.

setup: Blank fixture field. Enter Cyrillic, an emoji and a combining mark; compare the resulting value.
pass: Value matches exactly and is submitted only after complete input.

setup: Blank fixture field with a non-Latin input source and existing composition state cleared.
pass: Expected text arrives without layout substitutions or a stuck composition.

setup: Focus a different fixture process during the arming period.
pass: No input reaches the new foreground process from the stale plan.

setup: Type in a disposable fixture field, then press Stop before typing ends.
pass: Input stops, no submit follows, and the stop status appears after input has ceased.

setup: Fixture input backend times out after a known partial effect.
pass: Agent does not replay the change or claim success.

setup: Stub SSE ends after a complete action line without a terminal event.
pass: No plan action is dispatched.

setup: Stub SSE emits a valid action prefix and a token-limit terminal event.
pass: No action in the prefix is dispatched.

setup: Model stub proposes more than 600 UTF-16 units followed by Enter.
pass: Neither truncated text nor Enter is sent; the limit is reported.
